episodes.155340: A stationary boundary draped across the area combined with ample low-level moisture has allowed showers to develop and drift over the east coast metro. After repeated rounds of heavy rainfall, flooding materialized across portions of Broward County.

events.narrative: Video reports from WSVN and WPLG confirm street flooding along US 1 and NE 6th street in Pompano Beach. Water exceeding the curb in some areas and roads completely covered in water, though still passable. Nearby rain gauges measured up to 4 inches of rain in a short time.
